content.title: Home - VA Homeless Programs
content.text: No Veteran should be homeless in the country they swore an oath to defend. That’s why VA is committed to ending homelessness among Veterans. It’s our nation’s duty to ensure that every Veteran has a safe and stable place to call home. Contact VA for help If you are a Veteran who is homeless or at imminent risk of homelessness, we strongly encourage you to contact the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at 877-424-3838 for assistance.The call is free, confidential, and available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Trained professionals are standing by to connect you to your nearest VA for help.
